content.title: Choose and continue a supplied piece
content.summary: Propose up to two typed continuations, select one, then use the actual selected contribution for a written next round.
content.setup: The host supplies an authorized starting_piece binding, eligible actors and contribution/voting windows. Filling limits or receiving every vote does not close a window early.
content.prompt: Choose and continue a supplied piece
content.participant: Read/play the actual supplied piece. Offer up to two text/image/audio continuations in total. Vote privately, then write one continuation of the selected piece in the next round.
content.completion: Present counts and selection; positive ties and nonempty zero-count outcomes choose randomly. No candidates gives no_candidates and blocks the next collection without fabricating source material.
content.access: The actual supplied starting contribution and its author/origin are visible to every bound viewer when collection begins. Continuations remain author-private until eligible candidates and attribution appear at voting entry. Ballots stay private after counts and selection appear. The selected piece is visible as input to the next round; new written submissions remain private.

provenance.rights: Authors retain rights to their contributions; this definition grants no media rights.

steps.prompt: Offer up to two text, image or audio continuations of the supplied starting piece.
Here are the counts, outcome and selected contribution, if any.
Write one continuation of the selected piece.
